pdf.desc.to_images: One image per page (in a folder when there are several pages)
pdf.desc.to_md: Markdown with headings, lists and tables
pdf.desc.to_html: A single HTML page with the images embedded
pdf.desc.compress.balanced: Images at 150 dpi: good for screen and email
pdf.desc.compress.light: Optimize without reducing the image resolution
pdf.desc.compress.strong: Images at 72 dpi: the smallest file
pdf.desc.compress.custom: Choose the image resolution and quality
pdf.desc.organize: Reorder, rotate, duplicate and delete pages
pdf.desc.extract_pages: A new PDF with the chosen pages
pdf.desc.delete_pages: A copy without the chosen pages
pdf.desc.rotate: Rotate every page (or the chosen ones)
pdf.desc.merge: One PDF in drop order, with a bookmark per file
pdf.desc.interleave: Fronts from the first PDF, backs from the second (scanned in reverse)
pdf.desc.combine: PDFs and images into one PDF, one page per image
pdf.desc.protect: AES-256 encryption with a password and permissions
pdf.desc.unlock: Remove the password and restrictions (the password is needed)
pdf.desc.redact: Permanently remove text, images and graphics under the areas
pdf.desc.strip_metadata: Remove author, software, dates and XMP data
pdf.desc.metadata: Edit title, author, subject, keywords and dates
pdf.desc.ocr: Add a selectable text layer to scanned pages
pdf.desc.copy_text: Copy the text to the clipboard (OCR for scans)
pdf.desc.extract_images: Embedded images in their original format
pdf.desc.extract_attachments: Files embedded in the PDF (e.g. the XML of an e-invoice)
pdf.desc.watermark: A text stamp on the pages
pdf.desc.flatten: Burn form fields and annotations into the pages
pdf.desc.annotate: Open in Xournal++ to annotate or sign
pdf.desc.info: Pages, sizes, version, security and fonts
pdf.prm.password.locked: “{name}” is password protected: enter the password to continue
pdf.prm.password.locked_many.one: 1 PDF is password protected: enter the password to continue
pdf.prm.password.locked_many.other: {n} PDFs are password protected: enter the password (the same for all)
pdf.prm.pages.help: E.g. 1-3, 5, 8-z (z = last page, odd/even, x4 excludes page 4)
pdf.prm.pages_all.help: Empty = all pages. E.g. 1-3, 5, 8-z (z = last page)
pdf.prm.quality.help: JPEG quality of the recompressed images
pdf.prm.ranges.help: One file per range, separated by commas: 1-3, 5, 7-
pdf.prm.reverse_second.help: Turn on when the backs were scanned starting from the last page
pdf.prm.margin.help: Only with A4 or Letter pages
pdf.prm.user_password.help: Leave empty to only restrict printing, copying or editing
pdf.prm.owner_password.help: Needed to change the permissions later; empty = same as the password to open
pdf.prm.unlock_password.help: The password used to open the PDF
pdf.prm.language.help: Tesseract codes joined by +, e.g. ita+eng
pdf.prm.number_format.help: {n} = page number, {total} = page count. E.g. Page {n} of {total}
pdf.err.password_needed: “{name}” is password protected: open the action options (Alt+Enter or right-click) and enter the password
pdf.err.no_icc: sRGB color profile not found (install ghostscript or colord)
pdf.err.nothing_to_split: Nothing to split: the result would be a single file
pdf.err.password_empty: Enter a password or restrict at least one permission
pdf.err.already_protected: “{name}” is already protected: unlock it first
pdf.err.encrypt_failed: The encryption could not be verified
pdf.err.nothing_to_redact: Draw at least one area or enter a text to redact
pdf.err.terms_not_found: The text to redact was not found
pdf.err.redact_verify: Redaction check failed: some content is still readable, so nothing was saved
pdf.err.ocr_dependency: A program needed by ocrmypdf is missing
pdf.err.has_text: {name} already contains text: choose “Redo the OCR”
pdf.err.no_text: No text found: the PDF is probably a scan
pdf.err.repair_failed: The PDF could not be repaired
pdf.warn.reprotected: The result is protected with the same password
pdf.warn.protection_removed: The result is not password protected
pdf.warn.markdown_basic: Basic Markdown: better results need PyMuPDF ≥ 2.0 from PyPI in a venv
pdf.warn.scan_docx: The PDF looks like a scan: run OCR first to get editable text
pdf.warn.pdfa_unprotected: A PDF/A cannot be encrypted: the result has no password
pdf.warn.lossless_only: Ghostscript is not installed: lossless optimization only
pdf.warn.redact_solid: In PDFs the areas are always blacked out (blur is not secure)
pdf.warn.pdfa_lost: Editing the metadata removes the PDF/A conformance
pdf.warn.ocr_fallback: ocrmypdf is not installed: basic OCR with tesseract
